title: Group a dashboard by a label

blocks.content: Use a filter variable with **Enable group by** turned on to group supported aggregations on your current dashboard. Add a label, inspect the results, and remove only the grouping you added.

Find the first **Group by** control on this dashboard. Open its label list, note an unused label without selecting it, then close the list. If this control is missing, open a dashboard with a filter variable that has **Enable group by** turned on.
blocks.tooltip: Use an available label that is not already applied.
blocks.hint: Open a dashboard with grouping enabled on a filter variable.

blocks.prompt: Enter an available label from the highlighted control’s list that is not already applied on this dashboard.
blocks.validationMessage: Use a label starting with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, numbers, or underscores.

blocks.content: Add your chosen label in the **Group by** control:
In **Group by**, type your chosen label and select that label.
blocks.tooltip: Choose an available label that is not already applied.
blocks.hint: Choose an available label that is not already applied on this dashboard.

blocks.content: Your grouping is now applied. Inspect panels using this variable’s data source to see how supported queries respond.
blocks.tooltip: Grouping applies to aggregations such as sum, avg, and count.

blocks.content: You grouped supported aggregations by a label without editing queries.
Remove only the grouping you added for your chosen label.
blocks.tooltip: Other filters and groupings remain in place.

blocks.content: You restored the previous grouping. To use this control on another dashboard, turn on **Enable group by** in its filter variable settings.
